comment: I found the 199 genetics class to be extremely easy. Most of the content was already presented to me in high school bio and AP Bio. Most 199 classes are on super random topics, but this one actually covers content that is useful for 200. Some people seemed to find the course somewhat hard, but if you have a bio background, it will likely be easy.
Kathy is an amazing human being, however, the way she taught the content did not click for me or my friends in the class. She's great though. It's me not her.

Ms. Z is a great professor. Her lectures are interesting and clear. Some of the questions are difficult, but she tells students before that they need to read through the test thoroughly. You'll be fine if you do so. Interesting class and she is very caring and flexible if something happens.

For Bio120: human genetics course, 4 exams and 1 presentation. Smaller homework assignments throughout the course, which are not stated in the syllabus-so make sure you check blackboard frequently. Book is a supplement. What will be on the exams are in the lecture slides.

Not a whole lot of content is covered in class. To do well, it is imperative that you are good at teaching yourself from the textbook. Class is still somewhat entertaining. Dr. Zoghby is very nice and the class atmosphere is always relaxed. Tests are not too bad, and the team quizzes are usually an aid to your grade. Would recommend.

You should only take this class if you like to read bio textbooks to learn everything. Pr. Zoghby doesn't teach anything really in class. Everything that I have learned was on my own. She gives weekly quizzes based on the weekly reading, but these quizzes demand an understanding greater than reading the text gives you. She will not teach in class!!

Professor Zoghby is a wonderful teacher. Even though her lectures can sometimes get a bit convoluted, she tries to make class interesting. She is always available outside of class is you need help and her exams test only what we've covered in class. Doing to assigned reading for this class, though, is very important. Overall an excellent class!

She is very nice and the class is highly discussion based. the discussions were interesting, but nothing new. the same nature vs. nurture, but it was cool learning new topics. books were also very enjoyable. she is tough in grading essays, and wouldnt pre-read or offer much help writing them. it was okay overall.

Zoghby is one of the nicest professors on campus! she has a very laid black class primarily focused on class discussion lead by students. None of the discussions were very insightful but they were entertaining. Although she is easy, be forewarned: still very difficult to get an A!!

Genes and Behavior was an interesting FYS topic and I really enjoyed all the books and discussions we had in class. Class was always laid back and Zoghby was such a great professor. Although I'm fairly certain she doesn't give A's on essays which are pretty much the only grades we have for the semester.
Very nice lady, moderate grader, overall relaxing and laid back class. I definitely recommend her as an FYS professor.
I was in Genes and Behavior and that class was a lot of fun. Professor Zoghby is really nice and understanding. Sometimes she isn't so clear in her assignments but she is always there to help

One of the nicest professors i've ever had. Definitely recommend her if you're willing to work for your grade. Not particularly easy but very helpful and wants her students to do well! Very understanding. Love her!
Def not a science major here...Dr. Zoghby was good overall I liked her.  Class was difficult but everyone was awful so the curve helped a lot.  Good teacher.

Very nice and completely interested in how her students are doing. Always trying to explain things and will pend extra time on anything the students need. The class starts out easy and then difficult but if you read the chapters before class you should do fine
She is extremely nice and helpful.  Makes it clear what she wants with no surprises.  She wants everyone to understand and do well
Mrs. Zoghby is a good teacher. She's nice and has a fairly chill attitude. While I wouldn't say she's amazing, I do think she's above average.

although the lab was a bit difficult, mrs. zoghby is a great lady.  very willing to help you out, extremely nice, and fairly laid back.  she can be a tough grader but she's definitely fair.  if you do the work you'll be fine.  she defintely wants students to do well.

genetics lab was sooo confusing. i     d the lab, but loved mrs. z! she was very helpful and kind, willing to walk with struggling students through the tough concepts. while not always clear in class, outside of class she's great! a great lab teacher for a terrible lab curriculum!

Although she was helpful, she was very unclear in what she wanted in lab reports until after they were already turned in.  She was not clear in explaining labs and expected us to figure everything out for ourselves.  She's a nice person and willing to help you out, just not particularly clear.
She is a very nice lady and is willing to help you when you have problems but is not very clear. Overall though, she helped me survive genetics.

This woman is a terrible grader, expects you to be able guess exactly how she wants a report laid out. She does not do a good job explaining the processes involved, and if you ask her for help she will describe the details of the the lab in the most circumspect way. Avoid her if you can for lab.
She's really awesome.  She's nice and funny and will help you if you don't understand a concept
she was awesome! so nice and helpful..really helps you get a good grade! i would recomend her!
